shortDescription: GitHub dashboard home and GitHub user profile overview views.
fullDescription: Top-level screen implementation that supports both the GitHub dashboard home view and the GitHub user profile overview view from one route using a local view selector. The dashboard home state renders the GitHub-style header, feed tabs, repository sidebar, activity feed, and updates rail, while the profile overview state renders the same shared top bar with profile navigation, summary sidebar, popular repositories, contribution heatmap, and year selector. Both view states remain interactive through explicit props and local state for selected tabs, search text, filters, and year selection.
